## Use from an MCP client instead of a shell

If your agent speaks MCP but can't run shell comman
ds (Claude Desktop, chat clients), run the same testing engine as a stdio MCP server:\n\n```bash theme={\"theme\":\"css-variables\

"}
npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest mcp
```

Connections to servers under test stay open between tool calls, so agents can also obser
ve notifications and session behavior that one-shot CLI commands can't. See [MCPJam as an MCP server](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/

mcp-server.md).

## What's next

* [MCPJam as an MCP server](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/mcp-server.md) — give MCP clients the
testing engine over stdio\n* [Server inspection](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/server-inspection.md) — probe, doctor, and diagnosti
cs\n* [OAuth conformance](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/oauth-conformance.md) — test your OAuth implementation\n* [OAuth login](http
s://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/oauth-login.md) — authenticate and debug OAuth flows\n* [MCP Apps conformance](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli
/apps-conformance.md) — validate `_meta.ui.resourceUri` and `ui://` resource wiring\n* [Tools, resources & prompts](https://docs.m
cpjam.com/cli/tools-resources-prompts.md) — exercise the connected surface\n* [Migrating to CLI 4.0](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/m
igration.md) — command-path and flag changes under `mcpjam cloud`\n* [Full command reference](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/referenc
